notes.title: Roots in the Sky - Demo available!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that you can finally play the demo for Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2!

If you like what you see, please [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b]!

We're also on Kickstarter at the moment, so please consider supporting us!
